application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Erection of an end-of-terrace three-bedroom house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be as specified in the application.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0001-P01 (received 18 January 2021); 3601-P02 (received 8 March 2021); 0011-P04 (received 30 April 2021); 3001-P03 (received 10 August 2021); Energy Statement, dated 10 August 2021 (received 17 August 2021)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the building hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 6 - Prior to commencement of development the final detailed drainage designs and associated full drainage maintenance plan shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved details to limit surface water runoff from the site to 5 l/s.

Condition : 7 - The building shall not be occupied until full details	of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials (including the storage enclosure) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The building shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these 		works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc). Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; 	schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate).

Development shall thereafter be implemented prior to first occupation of the development in accordance with the approved details and maintained in accordance thereafter.

Condition : 10 - The building shall not be occupied until the means of access shown on the approved drawings have been constructed in accordance with the approved plans including visibility splays at 	the entrance. Visibility splays that comply with the Residential Crossovers and Off-Street Parking Policy are to be provided as far as possible (ie. splays of 2.4 metres by 2.4 metres are to be provided on each side of the vehicular access, measured along the back of the footway and into the site). These splays shall be permanently retained as such thereafter and shall be kept permanently clear of any obstruction to visibility above 600mm 	on land within the approved development site.

Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works on site the applicant is to submit to the Council a revised plan which introduces a low wall or fence (600mm high or lower) along the back of the footway to prevent cars being driven over unsupported sections of the footway. The development shall not thereafter be implemented other than in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.

Condition : 13 - The building shall not be occupied until full details (including 	manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be 		made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 14 - All recommendations and requirements contained within the approved 'Energy Statement' by EnergyTest and dated 10 August 2021 are to be implemented in their entirety into the 		development and therefore retained as such.

Condition : 15 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure should be submitted 	to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 16 - Prior to first occupation of the new dwelling, the applicant shall have entered into a formal agreement with the Council to provide a payment of ?2871 towards its Carbon Offset Fund, as outlined in the hereby approved Energy Statement.
